title: Liquid glass capsule squash and stretch
summary: One refractive glass shape over a dark red striped shader: a wide capsule squeezes into a small circle, swells into a large lens, then stretches into a thin full-width bar. Spring overshoot on every change makes the glass feel elastic.
use_when: Showing off a glass material or a liquid-glass UI style with no copy
A loopable ambient background or interstitial between product shots
Teasing a control (button, search bar, toggle) before its UI appears
A dark, single-accent brand that wants motion without type

look.type_style: no type: the glass shape is the only subject

sfx.event: glass shape settles after each squash or stretch
circle swells into the large lens

structure.shot: wide glass capsule (0.55 W x 0.41 H) centred over diagonal red stripes, then squeezes sideways into a small circle
structure.camera: locked frame, no camera move; only the shader stripes drift diagonally
structure.motion: capsule holds f0-8, width 0.55 W -> 0.20 W at f23 (undershoot) -> 0.24 W at f30, height kept 0.41-0.43 H; springs.pop, overshoot ~13 % (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: small glass circle (0.24 W) holds at centre, the stripes refract and shift inside its rim
structure.camera: locked frame, no camera move; stripes drift and dim slowly
structure.motion: circle finishes settling 0.20 W -> 0.24 W by f30 (±0.25 s), then holds 45 fr, centre fixed at 0.51 W / 0.50 H; no scale change within ±2 %

structure.shot: circle swells into a large glass lens (0.49 W, 0.87 H) and holds while the stripes behind dim
structure.camera: locked frame, no camera move; stripes drift, highlight band fades out by f120
structure.motion: diameter 0.24 W -> 0.53 W peak at f90 -> 0.49 W settled by f98; springs.pop, overshoot ~16 % (±0.25 s); hold 52 fr

structure.shot: lens stretches into a wide capsule, then a thin full-width glass bar (0.91 W x 0.16 H) that holds over a brightening red hot spot
structure.camera: locked frame, no camera move; red hot spot grows in the lower left from f180
structure.motion: f150 circle -> f158 capsule 0.78 W x 0.38 H -> f165 bar 0.92 W x 0.10 H shifted left to the edge -> f173 recentred, height rebounds -> settled 0.91 W x 0.16 H by f180; springs.pop squash and stretch (overshoot not measurable); hold 39 fr

params.accent: stripe colour of the shader background (brand accent, default deep red)
params.shapes: sequence of glass states {w, h, at}: capsule -> small circle -> large circle -> thin bar
params.holdFrames: frames each state holds before the next morph (measured 30-52 fr)

notes: Single continuous shot, 0 cuts, silent. Rows split at shape state changes read from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). The glass refracts the background: stripes inside the rim are offset and bent, the rim is a thin red-tinted hairline. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): squash-stretch-morph (one glass shape changes aspect on a spring, rows 1-4); stripe-shader (diagonal blurred light bands drifting, rows 1-4). Catalogue hint 'physics' not used: no falling or collision, only spring morphs. Missing components: LiquidGlassShape, StripeShaderBackground.
